$comment: Worked vectors of the contributor page alias's addressMac (design PROFILE-PAGE-2026-10-06 §2.3, §7.2; the definition is in schemas/contributor-page-alias.v1.json): HMAC-SHA256 under the key over the UTF-8 bytes of "u-login:" and the login in ASCII lower case, then the first 26 characters of the lower-case RFC 4648 base32 encoding of the 32-byte digest, without padding.

The api (C#) computes the MAC when it assigns or retires an address, and the website edge (JavaScript) computes it for every /u/{login} request. If the two disagree by one character, every login address answers 404, so both run every vector here, and check:contributor-page recomputes each one. `hmacSha256Hex` is the digest before base32, so a failing implementation can tell a wrong message or key from a wrong encoding.

`keyHex` is a PUBLISHED TEST KEY, the SHA-256 of a fixed sentence, and is never PSN_PAGE_ALIAS_KEY in any environment. The real key is 32 random bytes held as 64 lower-case hex characters, and the HMAC key is always the 32 decoded bytes, never the hex text.

vectors.note: The login of examples/contributor-page.v1.example.json, whose page has the login address; the alias at this path is examples/contributor-page-alias.v1.example.json.
The same login in mixed case: GitHub logins are case-insensitive, the message lower-cases it, so the MAC and the path are AV-1's.
